{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Count: number of converted customers
num_converted = len(converted_customers)

# Exclude rows where age is -1 (sentinel for missing)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Count: number of valid ages
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all necessary values for evidence
print(f"Number of converted customers: {num_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age (not -1): {num_valid_ages}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")"}
